description:
Based off our Ventura Allroad bike but using custom long point lugs, this unique design features a distinctive pink ‘splash’ as if ridden through a pink puddle of paint – a nod to the famous Paul Smith ‘pink’ store on Melrose Avenue, LA.

Incorporating the iconic Mercian barbers pole, with the lugs subtly picked out, it is finished with the Mercian/Paul Smith 80year head badge.
